public_rationale: Public testimony and a filed complaint implicate chatbots in the suicides of Sewell Setzer III and Adam Raine. Filed litigation and contemporary reporting also implicate ChatGPT in the Tumbler Ridge mass killing. These records meet Marcus's wording, which says 'implicated' rather than proven responsible.
limitations: The allegations are not findings of causation or liability.
NPR reporting was used for Setzer because the Senate materials could not be read.
The mass-killing sources disagree by one day on the incident date.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Chatbots have been implicated in a number of suicides and even in mass murder.

statement.excerpt: Chatbots have been implicated in a number of suicides, and even mass murder.
statement.document_title: Coming soon: New York City’s hearing on AI risks

our_interpretation: 'Implicated' means linked through substantive public allegations, investigations or findings; it does not mean proven to have caused a death.
Use at least four victims killed, excluding the perpetrator, as a conservative operational meaning of mass murder.
The present-perfect wording describes the cumulative public record through publication, rather than only the latest quarter.
criteria.support_condition: Public records implicate chatbots in at least two completed suicides and at least one intentional killing of four or more victims by October 5, 2026.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable records establish that the alleged examples do not meet these conditions, with sufficient coverage to reject either component.
